mapping.author: claude-mapper-fdn-m5
mapping.draft_py:
# FDN Good-Fortune Unicorn: "Whenever another creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on
# that creature."
# Event: Impassioned Orator's verified "another creature you control enters". "That creature" is the
# triggering object, the event referent of M20 Marauding Raptor's verified "deals 2 damage to it".
trigger = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAnd(
            children=(
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
                FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.TYPE_EQ, string_value='Creature'),
                FNot(inner=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE)),
            ),
        ),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.PUT_COUNTER, {
        'count': QConst(value=1),
        'counter_kind': CounterKind.PLUS_1_PLUS_1,
        'target': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAnd(children=()),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            referent='event',
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [trigger, *compiled]

clauses.clause: Whenever another creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.

mapping.notes: Impassioned Orator's event; 'that creature' is Marauding Raptor's verified event referent. The probe shows the counter on the entering creature (the BACKLOG's 'placed no counter' note was the old tree). packs in tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/: good_fortune_unicorn_counter_on_each_returned_creature.
